text:
zoe: customer reported weird SSE resume: after network flip parts replayed and UI showed duplicated fragments. sampleapp attached.

liam: did they see a resume-token header on reconnect?

nora: yes server sends resume-token but proxy replayed trailing bytes from the old connection. stream showed same message id split across conns.

pat: paste raw capture?

nora: snippet:

event: message
data: {"id":"m-007","part":1,"text":"Good "}

--conn drop--

event: message
data: {"id":"m-007","part":2,"text":"morning"}

event: message
data: {"id":"m-007","part":2,"text":"morning"}

nora: client applied both part=2 fragments -> "Good morningmorning" in some runs.

liam: root cause: SDK resume logic trusts reconnect stream without dedupe. fix: clients must dedupe by (id,part) and buffer partial JSON until parse succeeds. also add TTL for orphaned partials.

zoe: agreed. proposed tasks: (1) add opt-in replay-harness to sampleapp, (2) unit tests for dedupe in node and android SDKs, (3) Node parser change to buffer across SSE boundary.

pat: I'll own android + sampleapp harness. liam take node. dev-bot: kicking CI job after PRs.

dev-bot: CI queued for branch fix/sse-resume-dedupe (#5177).

zoe: thanks team — I'll notify customer and follow up after QA.
